en: Route popover placement through the frame pipeline, pause settings previews in hidden tabs and stop per-tick layout reads in the caret preview, refresh the waiting line's seconds once a second, skip rewrites of unchanged search corpus cache documents and prune the directory by age, and drop document-wide relational-selector matching from canvas rules
